name: Word-RAM
description: The input occupies O(n) machine words. Each word contains w = Θ(log n) bits. Reading or writing one word and applying standard arithmetic, comparison, bitwise, and shift operations to O(1) words take O(1) time. State explicitly whether multiplication, randomization, or nonstandard word operations are allowed.

name: Comparison model
description: Keys come from a totally ordered universe and may be inspected only through pairwise comparisons. The primary cost is the number of comparisons; bookkeeping, index manipulation, and movement of O(1) keys take O(1) time unless stated otherwise.

name: Cell-probe model
description: Memory is an array of cells containing w bits each. Computation between memory accesses is free, and cost is the number of cell reads and writes. State the word size w, space bound, preprocessing allowance, update model, and whether randomization is permitted.

name: CONGEST
description: The input is distributed over an n-node communication network. Computation proceeds in synchronous rounds, and in each round every endpoint may send an O(log n)-bit message across each incident edge. Local computation is free; complexity is the number of rounds.

name: Deterministic multitape Turing machine
description: Use a deterministic multitape Turing machine with a constant number of tapes and a fixed finite alphabet. The input length is n, and running time is the number of transitions until halting. Any encoding conventions and output representation must be stated explicitly.
